TABLE.NAME: local_scribbles
TABLE.COMMENT: Saved annotated screenshots. The image itself is in the user's file area, itemid = id.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who saved the screenshot

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Context of the page the screenshot was taken on (may since have been deleted)

FIELD.NAME: pageurl
FIELD.COMMENT: URL of the page the screenshot was taken on

FIELD.NAME: pagetitle
FIELD.COMMENT: Title of the page the screenshot was taken on
